text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bernard-Soulier Syndrome. This rare autosomal recessive disorder presents with thrombocytopenia, giant platelets on smear, and mucocutaneous bleeding due to a defect in the platelet GPIb-IX-V complex. Confirmation would require a bleeding time test showing prolongation and a flow cytometry panel for GPIb deficiency, but the clinical picture is definitive.
